name: Bürgeramt 3 Friedrichshain (file your application here)
address: Frankfurter Allee 35/37, 10247 Berlin — Passage, Aufgang B
notes: Your nearest intake counter, and the one where you'd collect the finished card. Appointment only. U5 Samariterstr. 200 m. Cards, Apple/Google Pay accepted. No document collection on Saturdays.

name: Bürgeramt 1 Kreuzberg (Yorckstraße)
notes: Second option in your own district — useful when Friedrichshain has no slots. Any Berlin Bürgeramt may take the application.

name: Bürgeramt 2.0 Schlesische Straße (Kreuzberg)
notes: Also hosts the Mobiles Bürgeramt. Appointment only.

name: LABO Fahrerlaubnisbehörde — decides your case AND issues your licence
notes: You file the application at a Bürgeramt, but you WILL come here at the end: for a conversion, licence issuance is handled exclusively by the Fahrerlaubnisbehörde. Book on (030) 90269-2300 or 115 and bring the original Prüfbescheinigung plus your original Argentine licence — that is where you get the provisional driving permission and surrender the Argentine licence. Appointment only: Mon–Thu 07:00–14:00, Fri 07:00–12:00.

name: Erste Hilfe Station Friedrichshain — first aid in English + free eye test + free photos
price: €72.99 online (€82.99 cash) incl. eye test and photos
notes: The most efficient stop on your whole list: three required documents in one session, in English, at a single Friedrichshain venue. Nine units of 45 min, about 7.5 hours. Book ONLINE — paying cash on the day adds €10. English dates run Thu–Sun. Photograph your certificate before you hand it in: the Bürgeramt keeps the original and a replacement copy costs €29.99.

name: Erste Hilfe Station Prenzlauer Berg
notes: Same all-in package, English courses. Six Berlin venues run the driving-licence course.

name: Erste Hilfe Station Charlottenburg (MediPoint)
notes: English courses; useful if Friedrichshain dates are full.

name: ANB Berlin — cheapest verified English course
address: Berlin (multiple venues — check the booking calendar)
notes: The lowest verified price for an English-language driving-licence first-aid course in Berlin. Does not bundle the eye test or photos, so compare the total against Erste Hilfe Station.

name: SoftAid Berlin — first-aid course
notes: Close to Friedrichshain, one of 14 Berlin venues. Note: not every date is a full English-language course — their FAQ says instructors otherwise hand out English translations and support you through the practical parts. Confirm the language when booking.

name: ASB Berlin-Südwest — first aid in English
notes: Established provider (Arbeiter-Samariter-Bund). Prices taken from their live booking system — older static pages still show €65/€60.

name: Johanniter Ausbildungszentrum Berlin
address: Berlin/Brandenburg training centre — street address unverified
notes: Large recognised provider and their Berlin/Brandenburg page does list English-language events, but the specific address, phone and price could not be verified. Check before travelling.

name: Fielmann Friedrichshain — free eye test
notes: Officially recognised Sehteststelle and genuinely free of charge. Certificate must be under 2 years old when you apply. Call ahead — whether you can just walk in is not stated anywhere official.

name: Fielmann Alexanderplatz (ALEXA)
notes: Free eye test; photo booth and dm store in the same mall if you want photos too.

name: Apollo Optik Alexanderplatz (ALEXA)
notes: Officially recognised Sehteststelle. The old fixed €6.43 fee was abolished in 2019 and Apollo publishes no price, so ask first — or just use Fielmann, which is free.

name: ADAC Berlin-Mitte — licence translation + classification
notes: The route the authority and driving schools point to. Order in person or online (5–7 working days by post). Ask for translation AND classification — you need both.

name: Court-sworn Spanish→German translators (online register)
address: Nationwide register — filter by Berlin + Spanisch
notes: Officially accepted alternative to ADAC and usually faster — but most do NOT provide the class classification, which you also need. Confirm before ordering.

name: Argentine Embassy — Consular Section
notes: Consular district covers Berlin, Brandenburg, Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia. An official body of the issuing state is on the accepted-translator list. Tel +49 30 2266 89 0. The free ANSV Certificado de Legalidad Internacional is obtained online, not here.

name: Italian Consulate General Berlin
notes: For passport and citizenship matters. It cannot convert your Argentine licence — German residence means Germany is the only country that may license you.

name: DEKRA Prüfstelle Berlin-Hohenschönhausen
notes: Closest DEKRA exam centre to Friedrichshain. Your driving school books the exams here against the Prüfauftrag — you cannot book directly.

name: DEKRA Prüfstelle Berlin-Tempelhof
notes: Theory exam available in English, Spanish and Italian at no extra cost.

name: DEKRA Prüfstelle Berlin-Reinickendorf
notes: Address conflict between sources — one gave Eichborndamm 111. Confirm with your driving school, which books the slot anyway.

name: TÜV Rheinland Prüfstelle Berlin-Schöneberg
notes: Berlin uniquely has both examiners. Fees are nationally fixed, so identical at TÜV and DEKRA. Pick whichever your school works with.

name: Asphalt Profis (International Driving School Berlin)
price: quoted individually — ask for an Umschreibung package
notes: The only Berlin school found with a dedicated non-EU conversion page, and it states the law correctly (both exams, no minimum lessons). Theory in German or English. Note: their published authority fees are outdated — trust them for teaching, not for fees.

name: Fahrschule 2Drive Perfect
notes: In Friedrichshain itself. English, German, Russian, Turkish per directory listing. Ask whether they handle third-country conversions.

name: Nice Fahrschule
notes: Same U5 stop as Bürgeramt 3, so you can register and apply in one trip. English and German. Confirm they take conversion candidates.

name: Fahrschule Kotti — Spanish-speaking
notes: Teaches in SPANISH (no English) — possibly your best fit, since you can also sit the theory exam in Spanish. Same district.

name: Fahrschule Südstern
notes: "We also speak and teach English" — theory and practical in English, multilingual study materials. U7 Südstern.

name: The English Driving School Oscar
notes: Long-established English-language school (since 2006). Further from Friedrichshain, but a strong English option.

name: AS Fahrschule — English theory course
notes: One of the few schools publishing actual prices, so useful as a benchmark when comparing quotes. Re-confirm before signing.

name: dm-drogerie markt — biometric photos
address: Grunerstr. 20 (ALEXA mall), 10179 Berlin — and branches citywide
notes: Cheapest verified option: you shoot the photo in the app, print at any dm photo station and pay at the till — you get six biometric photos plus a digital copy. Free at Erste Hilfe Station if you do the first-aid course there.

name: Photo booth (Fotofix) — Ostbahnhof
notes: Nearest station booth to Friedrichshain. Choose the biometric/ID setting, not the fun one.
